description: Extract shared route constants to eliminate duplication across Navbar.tsx, Footer.tsx, and sitemap.ts. Create a single source of truth in app/lib/routes.ts that all three modules import from.
steps: Create app/lib/routes.ts exporting: (a) a ROUTES array of objects with href, label, and optional metadata (category for footer grouping, includeInNav boolean, includeInSitemap boolean), (b) a BASE_URL constant ('https://kirohub.dev'), (c) helper functions like getNavRoutes(), getFooterRoutes() (grouped by category), getSitemapRoutes()
Update app/components/Navbar.tsx to import navLinks from app/lib/routes.ts using getNavRoutes() instead of the inline navLinks array
Update app/components/Footer.tsx to import footerLinks from app/lib/routes.ts using getFooterRoutes() instead of the inline footerLinks object
Update app/sitemap.ts to import routes from app/lib/routes.ts using getSitemapRoutes() and BASE_URL instead of the inline routes array and baseUrl string
Run npm run build and npm run lint to verify no regressions
acceptance_criteria: A single app/lib/routes.ts file is the source of truth for all navigation paths
Navbar.tsx, Footer.tsx, and sitemap.ts all import from app/lib/routes.ts with no inline route arrays
npm run build passes with exit code 0
npm run lint passes with no errors
All existing routes remain unchanged in the built output
verification: Run: npm run build - expect exit code 0
Run: npm run lint - expect no errors
